description: Ingest videos into a collection now: each URL is a video or a list (playlist, channel, feed), and lists are expanded. Transcripts come from captions first, speech-to-text only when needed. Videos already in the collection are skipped and per-video failures are reported without stopping. Returns the updated collection and a summary (added, skipped, failed with hints).

urls.description: Video, playlist, channel or feed URLs
